description: I’m V. Ajay Kumar, a CSE (AI & ML) student passionate about AI, ML, LLMs, and innovative projects. Skilled in Python, Deep Learning, and Transformers. Looking for teammates skilled in AI/ML, coding, UI/UX, IoT, research, and problem-solving to build impactful solutions.
summary: Our project focuses on developing an AI-powered platform for detecting multiple neurological disorders using Electroencephalogram (EEG) signals. The system aims to identify diseases such as Alzheimer's disease, Epilepsy, and Schizophrenia by analyzing brainwave patterns. We use advanced deep learning techniques, including Transformer models, combined with XGBoost to improve classification performance. EEG datasets are collected, cleaned, preprocessed, and converted into a standardized format for model training. The trained model evaluates EEG signals and predicts the corresponding neurological condition. We also integrate portable EEG hardware to capture brain signals in real time, enabling practical applications beyond offline dataset analysis. The platform provides disease predictions along with performance evaluation metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and confusion matrix. Our ultimate goal is to develop an accessible, intelligent, and efficient preliminary screening system that supports healthcare professionals in neurological disease assessment.
details: Our project, Multi-Disease Neurodegenerative Detection Platform Using Deep Learning and EEG Signals, aims to detect Alzheimer's disease, Epilepsy, and Schizophrenia by analyzing brainwave patterns. The system collects EEG signals from existing datasets and portable EEG hardware. These signals are preprocessed, cleaned, and analyzed using Transformer-based deep learning models combined with XGBoost for disease classification. We use Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, NumPy, Pandas, Google Colab, and Jupyter Notebook for development. For hardware integration, we use a portable EEG device and ESP32 microcontroller. The major benefits include automated EEG analysis, faster preliminary screening, reduced manual effort, and improved accessibility to neurological screening technology. Our project's innovation lies in combining advanced AI models with portable EEG hardware to support real-time brain signal analysis. We considered data quality, patient privacy, model performance, processing speed, hardware compatibility, and scalability. Our intended impact is to support healthcare professionals and contribute to accessible neurological healthcare through AI technology.
